Class Customer

java.lang.Object
bank.model.Customer
public class Customer extends Object
============================================================================ Customer.java Owner: Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu) ============================================================================ REPRESENTS: A bank customer who owns multiple accounts. This class manages the customer's profile, authentication security (hashed PINs, lockouts), and provides access to their account and transaction history. SECURITY: - PINs are never stored in plaintext. They are hashed using SHA-256. - Implements a 3-strike lockout policy for failed login attempts. ============================================================================

  • Method Details

    • verifyPin

      public boolean verifyPin(String rawPin)
      Authenticates the customer by comparing the provided PIN with the stored hash. Also manages the failed attempt counter and account locking.
      Parameters:
      rawPin - The plaintext PIN provided by the user.
      Returns:
      true if the PIN is correct and the account is not locked; false otherwise.

    • hashPin
